summary.name: LocationSimulator
summary.one_liner: A macOS app that spoofs the GPS location of an iOS, iPadOS, or iPhone Simulator device for testing location-based apps.
use_cases: test location services on network-connected iPhone
summary.what_it_does: LocationSimulator lets a developer set the location of a connected iOS or iPhone Simulator device from a macOS app. Locations can be set by long-clicking on a map, searching for places, or entering coordinates. Movement can be simulated with predefined or custom speeds (Walk, Cycle, Drive), controlled with arrow keys, or navigated from one point to another. It can also open GPX files and supports network-connected devices. The app attempts to download DeveloperDiskImage files for the device's iOS version automatically.
notable: Spoofs device location without a jailbreak or installing an app on the device
Supports GPX file import and AppleScript automation
Installable via zip download or Homebrew
WatchOS and tvOS only partially supported
caveats: Homebrew version may be slightly outdated
Author does not support or encourage use for cheating in iOS games
